Shuppet

Ghost

Hoenn · Generation 3

Shuppet is a Ghost-type Puppet Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 2.3 kg. It evolves into Banette. Its highest base stat is Attack (75), with a base stat total of 295.
